jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Summary**

GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale.

**Role & Responsibilities**

As a Project Coordinator, you will join our Aerospace & Defense team onsite in our Carson, CA office to keep aerospace and defense robot cell projects moving from design through deployment and activation:

**Robot cell design**

* Maintain the project schedule, milestone tracker, and action log for each robot cell design effort, in close coordination with the Project Lead Engineer
* Organize design reviews, capture decisions and open items, and follow up until each item closes
* Track customer requirements, part and process specifications, and change requests, and keep revision control on shared documentation
* Coordinate with mechanical, controls, software, and process engineers so that inputs arrive when the final design needs to be locked in

**Deployment**

* Manage procurement tracking, supplier lead times, and delivery status for cell components, tooling, fixtures, and safety hardware
* Plan shipping, receiving, and site logistics, including customs and export documentation handled with GMR compliance
* Build and maintain installation plans, site readiness checklists, and travel schedules for the deployment team
* Serve as a point of contact for customer facilities, security, and EHS teams on access, badging, and scheduling

**Activation**

* Prepare commissioning and acceptance test plans with the Project Lead Engineer, and track each step through completion
* Record punch list items, test results, and customer sign offs, and assemble the turnover package
* Coordinate operator training sessions and handoff to GMR support teams for ongoing service

**Project administration**

* Prepare weekly status reports covering schedule, budget, risks, and decisions needed, for GMR leadership and customer stakeholders
* Track project budgets, purchase orders, and invoicing milestones with Finance
* Maintain a risk and issue register and raise schedule or scope concerns early
* Own deadline tracking for each project: monitor milestone and deliverable dates, escalate at risk items to the Project Lead Engineer promptly, and drive follow up so commitments to customers are met
* Apply ITAR and customer information handling requirements to every document, file, and communication

**Export Control Requirements**

In order to comply with the export regulations of the United States Government, it is required that the applicant must fall under one of the following categories: (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (i.e. current green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing operations, supply chain, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience supporting robotics, automation, or capital equipment installations from design through commissioning
* 2 to 4 years of project coordination, program support, or project management experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or industrial automation
* Demonstrated record of meeting deadlines, including tracking milestones, flagging risks early, and following up until work is delivered
* Working knowledge of project scheduling and tracking tools such as ClickUp, MS Project, or Smartsheet, plus strong Excel skills
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to brief engineers, executives, and customer stakeholders
* A reliable self-starter, highly organized, resourceful, with attention to detail, and the ability to manage several workstreams at once
* Ability to travel to customer sites, typically for short trips when needed, and work onsite at GMR
* Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across multiple teams
* Willingness to work in a fast-paced environment with quickly changing priorities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with aerospace and defense manufacturing environments and customer requirements, including AS9100 quality practices
* Understanding of ITAR, EAR, CUI handling, and export documentation
* Exposure to factory acceptance and site acceptance testing
* Working toward a PMP, CAPM, or similar project management qualification
* Ability to obtain a U.S. government security clearance if a program requires it

*GrayMatter Robotics provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage and embrace applicants of all backgrounds to apply!*

jobs.title: Intake Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Come join an exciting and innovative company that puts the “care” back in healthcare!**

At KabaFusion, our patients come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire GREAT people, period! Our culture celebrates and supports the differences that make us unique. Here, it doesn’t matter what your role is, your hard work and dedication is not only recognized but celebrated. Join us and find out why this is the place to excel and do your best work.

**About Us:**

What started as a single pharmacy in 2010 has grown into KabaFusion becoming the largest privately held home infusion company in the country. We have a national network of pharmacies and nursing offices strategically placed to service 40+ states. Couple that with over 30 years of combined experience and it’s no wonder why KabaFusion is the industry leader in home infusion.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

This position is responsible for the coordination and supports the intake function, managing intake documentation, payor requirements, and cross-functional scheduling to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. This role blends operational rigor with light project management, serving as a liaison between intake staff and leadership to drive process improvements and maintain compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

1. Write, maintain, and update Intake Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to reflect current workflows, policy changes, and best practices.

2. Maintain and update the payor handbook, including payor-specific requirements, timelines, and submission guidelines; track policy changes and translate them into actionable process updates.

3. Manage calendars and schedule intake-related meetings across departments (operations, clinical, billing, etc.).

4. Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, minutes, and follow-up action items to ensure timely execution.

5. Maintain project documentation for intake process improvement initiatives, including action logs, scope changes, and post-project evaluations.

6. Serve as a liaison between intake staff and leadership to support process improvement project implementation.

7. Review, categorize, and ensure accurate and timely distribution of incoming faxes and other intake documentation to the appropriate department or stakeholders.

8. Monitor intake processes for adherence to SOPs and payor requirements; identify recurring issues or bottlenecks and propose solutions.

9. Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA) and organizational standards.

10. Perform other duties as assigned by leadership to support departmental goals.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

Education:

* High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

Experience:

* Minimum of two (2) years of experience in operations, intake, project coordination, or a related role; healthcare or revenue cycle management experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build stakeholder engagement and drive action.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams) and/or electronic health record or payor portal systems preferred.

Skills and Competencies:

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent workstreams.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive compensation
* **Benefits start on your 1st day of employment**
* **401k w 4% match – no waiting or vesting period**
* PTO / Floating Holidays / Paid Holidays
* Company paid life insurance, short term disability
* Employee Assistance programs to help with mental health / wellness
* Learning & Development Programs
* Perks… includes discounts on travel, cell phone, clothing and more…
* Generous employee referral program

**To learn more about KabaFusion, please visit our careers page:** **https://www.kabafusion.com/careers/**

**Join us and find out why this is the place to excel and do your best work.**

jobs.description:
Under the supervision of the Operations Director, the Events Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for all events at the James Lawson Jr. Worker Justice Center (JLWJC) and is the public face of the Labor Center during events. This position manages the complete event lifecycle, from initial reservation intake through post-event inspection and follow-up, ensuring seamless coordination across 11-15 weekly events ranging from small 3-person meetings to community gatherings of 75+ attendees. The role works closely with staff, students, external partners, and community members to deliver consistent, reliable support. The Events Coordinator works a flexible, adjusted schedule built around the events calendar. Standard hours are Monday-Friday from 8AM to 5PM, supporting daytime events and handling administrative responsibilities. Beyond standard hours, the coordinator is expected to provide on-site coverage for approximately 4 evening events and 5-7 weekend events per month, with the weekly schedule adjusted accordingly. Additional overtime hours may be available depending on operational needs. The ideal candidate demonstrates a genuine commitment to community service and the Labor Center's values, brings exceptional customer service skills, and is warm, professional, and responsive in all interactions. Strong organizational and collaborative skills are essential as the coordinator manages multiple events interfacing with several stakeholders. The role requires reliability, effective communication, and schedule flexibility, particularly regarding evening and weekend availability. The incumbent should be comfortable troubleshooting and problem solving independently during live events, working with scheduling systems, email, and basic office tools, and being on their feet and moving through the facility throughout the day. We value community, reliability, and a service mindset over a long resume. The Operations Director will support the incumbent with training, mentorship, and the tools needed to succeed.

jobs.title: Social Media & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Social Media & Operations Coordinator to run our social media and work as the Director of Operations' right hand. You'll own Rejuve's social channels end to end, from filming in the clinic to posting and tracking results, and you'll keep the office, the calendar and our projects running smoothly. It's a role for someone who's equally at home behind a camera and on top of the details, and who wants a real hand in growing a clinic.

What you'll do

**Social media (about half your time)**

* Plan, film, edit and post content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and Google Business Profile, on a weekly calendar.
* Film the team in the clinic: treatments, room prep, "what to expect" explainers, team intros and event-prep content.
* Make sure every patient on camera has a signed media waiver on file before filming. No exceptions.
* Keep patient information out of frame and keep every post accurate: no promises about results, and anything describing treatments, drugs or risks goes to the Director of Operations for review first.
* Answer comments and DMs, and arrange booking inquiries same day.
* Track what works each week (reach, follow growth, inquiries, new clients who found us on social) and report it.

**Operations coordinator & assistant**

* Coordinate meetings and add them to the Director of Operations' and the Owner's calendars.
* Track email follow-ups and push them through until they're closed.
* Take on projects for the Owner, assigned and prioritized by the Director of Operations, and see them through to done.
* Draft emails, documents, SOPs and team announcements.
* Run errands and handle personal tasks as needed.
* Keep projects on track: notes, deadlines, reminders and follow-through.

**Office operations**

* Order office, drink and snack supplies; track vendors and deliveries.
* Keep the office clean and patient-ready between cleaner visits: take out trash and recycling, tidy the lobby, front desk and break room, and wash dishes.
* Coordinate with the cleaner, building management, IT and vendors.
* Help with community events, business partnerships and group bookings.
* Keep office systems organized: Slack, shared drives, Zenoti and Homebase.

What you bring

* 2+ years running social media for a business, ideally in beauty, wellness, aesthetics or health. Show us a portfolio or accounts you've grown.
* Comfortable filming and editing short video on a phone (CapCut, Instagram Edits or similar), and comfortable on camera yourself.
* 1+ year as an executive assistant, office manager or personal assistant.
* Highly organized, fast, discreet. You'll handle confidential business and patient-adjacent information.
* Clear, warm writer with a good eye for design (Canva, Figma or similar).
* Reliable car and valid California driver's license for errands.

Nice to have

* Med spa or medical office experience, and familiarity with HIPAA.
* Experience with Zenoti, Meta Business Suite, Later or similar tools.

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

IMPEX Technologies is a nationally recognized technology solutions provider helping enterprise, SLED, and healthcare organizations modernize infrastructure, strengthen resilience, and operate with confidence. For more than 25 years, we have delivered mission-critical solutions across infrastructure, cloud, security, and data for demanding IT environments. IMPEX Technologies is seeking a Junior Account Manager to generate pipeline and support growth across new and existing client accounts in Greater Los Angeles. In this client-facing role, you will prospect into target accounts, book qualified meetings, understand customer needs, nurture relationships, and connect clients with the right technology solutions. **Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is preferred not required, along with comfort using common productivity tools.

* Starting at $60,000 + performance-based incentives
* 401(k) matching• Dental insurance• Health insurance• Paid time off• Vision insurance

jobs.title: Account Manager - Hardware Sales
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Join the EandM Sales Team and help our customers build the future.

Our account managers sell automation solutions to engineers and operations teams solving real-world problems. If you want to sell something you can be proud of, this is the role.

We work in industries ranging from aerospace to food and beverage to solar energy and beyond.

**Who is EandM?**

EandM is a value-added distributor of Siemens, Festo, SICK, and other manufacturers. With a sixty-year history, we are proud of our heritage and work hard as a team. Our automation product lines are industry leaders on the West Coast.

**A Day in the Life of an EandM Account Manager**

As a salesperson at EandM, you will craft solutions based on partnerships with your customers, meeting their technical and business requirements for each project. It's satisfying work - different and demanding every day.

EandM Account Managers have curious minds and a commitment to ongoing training and education. They bring the drive and enthusiasm; we provide a world-class technical team and product lineup.

This role rewards people who are self-motivated, proactive about prospecting, and energized by building new relationships - not just managing existing ones. That said, we're willing to consider applicants at all experience levels. What will really impress us is your work ethic, curiosity, and intelligence.

**What We Expect from Our Account Managers**

* Develop and maintain direct customer relationships, including prospecting and building relationships with new accounts.
* Log sales activities (phone calls, site visits, quotes) in our CRM to stay on track.
* Evaluate potential accounts by assessing account potential, competition, and business needs.
* Provide sales support at EandM roadshows and workshops.
* Follow up on leads generated through EandM's ongoing marketing programs.
* Identify the cost of a customer's problem and deliver a solution of superior value.
* Maintain a high daily volume of calls and customer visits - this is a high-volume sales environment, and that activity is central to the role.

You'll work partly from a home office, partly from the road, and partly from our office in Irvine, servicing customers in the greater Los Angeles territory.  
**Experience and Skills:**

**What Experience Does a Successful EandM Account Manager Need?**

We're open to candidates at all experience levels. Here's what we're looking for:

*Must have:*

* Proven sales experience - the ability to initiate customer contact and grow revenue with new and existing customers is the number one requirement.
* Computer literacy and strong organizational skills, with a commitment to documenting sales activity.

*Nice to have:*

* Technical knowledge in industrial automation, networking, or IT
* Sales experience in our industry (or other technical sales experience)
* Familiarity with PLCs, industrial sensors, or pneumatics.
* Bachelor's degree in an engineering field.

If you don't check every box but believe you're the right person for this role, we want to hear from you.  
**Job Benefits:**

**Compensation and Benefits**

This is a base-plus-commission position with a competitive base salary. On-plan total compensation is $85,000–$120,000. Your earning potential grows with your results.

Full benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), life insurance, short- and long-term disability, and four weeks PTO.

**How to Apply**

You're a sales professional - sell yourself to us. Show us how you've built relationships, grown revenue, or found opportunities where others didn't. We're willing to consider candidates at all experience levels, so convince us you're the perfect fit.

*EandM is an E-Verify and Equal Opportunity Employer.*

From: EandM

**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SUPPLY CHAIN**

Rocket Lab's Supply Chain team is responsible for the flow of all materials, products, and components through the business. With many of our own products functioning as critical components to our own and our customers' missions, the Supply Chain team has a direct impact on the success of our rocket and satellite programs. They set up the assembly kits that enables our technicians to put together our Electron rockets, manage inventory, look after shipping and receiving, manage direct and indirect procurement, and inspect and ensure that all of our materials and products are compliant and up to standard. They are the chain that links our teams together, and are critical to our success.

**PRODUCTION COORDINATOR II**

Based onsite at Rocket Labs headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Production Coordinator II follows up with production areas for updated status on open work orders, expedites deliveries where needed, and help resolve any blockers preventing on time delivery. jobs.title: Certified Medical Assistant/Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a compassionate, detail-oriented, and highly organized **Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) who is fluent in both English and Spanish and proficient in phlebotomy** to join our OB/GYN practice.

This dual-role position combines hands-on clinical support with clinical research coordination. The ideal candidate will be comfortable providing direct patient care, performing blood draws, collecting and processing specimens, coordinating clinical research visits, and maintaining accurate medical and research documentation.

The successful candidate must be able to communicate effectively with English- and Spanish-speaking patients while helping deliver high-quality women's healthcare and supporting clinical research initiatives.

Key ResponsibilitiesClinical & Medical Assistant Duties

* Room patients, obtain vital signs, and update medical histories, medications, and allergies.
* Perform venipuncture and blood draws accurately and safely.
* Collect, label, process, and prepare blood and other specimens for laboratory testing or research shipment.
* Prepare patients for examinations and assist providers with OB/GYN procedures as directed.
* Perform point-of-care testing and other authorized clinical tasks.
* Administer medications, injections, or vaccines when authorized and appropriately trained.
* Maintain exam rooms, clinical supplies, and laboratory equipment.
* Assist with scheduling, referrals, prescription requests, and patient follow-up.
* Maintain accurate electronic health records (EHR) and protect patient confidentiality.
* Provide clear communication and patient support in both English and Spanish.

Clinical Research Coordinator Duties

* Coordinate clinical research activities under the direction of the Principal Investigator (PI).
* Assist with participant recruitment, prescreening, eligibility verification, and enrollment according to approved study protocols.
* Schedule research visits, procedures, specimen collections, and follow-up appointments.
* Obtain informed consent only when appropriately trained, delegated, and authorized.
* Collect, process, document, and track research specimens according to study requirements.
* Maintain accurate study records, source documentation, case report forms, and electronic data entry.
* Track study milestones, participant visits, and follow-up activities.
* Assist with regulatory documentation, study binders, training records, and protocol amendments.
* Communicate with investigators, sponsors, laboratories, and research participants as appropriate.
* Support monitoring visits, audits, and quality assurance activities.
* Promptly report protocol deviations, adverse events, and other reportable issues to the appropriate research leadership.

Required Qualifications

* Current Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) credential or another employer-approved medical assistant certification.
* **Fluency in both Spanish and English, with the ability to communicate effectively with patients in both languages.**
* Demonstrated competency and experience in phlebotomy and venipuncture.
* Experience in a physician's office, outpatient clinic, laboratory, or comparable healthcare setting.
* Knowledge of patient confidentiality, HIPAA, infection prevention, and specimen handling.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate documentation practices.
* Proficiency with electronic health records and basic computer applications.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining patient safety and research data quality.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in OB/GYN, women's health, fertility, maternal health, or reproductive medicine.
* Previous clinical research coordination or clinical trial experience.
* Familiarity with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), informed consent, and human-subject protection requirements.
* Experience with electronic data capture (EDC) platforms and clinical research management systems.
* Knowledge of FDA-regulated clinical research and Institutional Review Board (IRB) requirements.
* Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification, if required by the practice.

Key Competencies

* Compassionate, patient-centered care.
* Strong phlebotomy and specimen collection skills.
* Fluency in Spanish and English.
* Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Professional communication and discretion.
* Effective time management and multitasking.
* Commitment to research integrity, regulatory compliance, and patient safety.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Work Environment

This position is based in an outpatient OB/GYN clinic and involves direct patient contact, blood collection, specimen processing, clinical procedures, and research-related administrative responsibilities. The employee must be comfortable working with sensitive patient information and supporting women's health research.

Compensation & Benefits

**Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, clinical skills, phlebotomy competency, and relevant clinical research background.**

Benefits may include:

* Paid time off and holidays, according to clinic policy.
* Health insurance and other benefits, if offered.
* Continuing education and professional development opportunities.
* Opportunities to expand expertise in women's health and clinical research.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume highlighting their medical assisting experience, phlebotomy skills, Spanish/English bilingual proficiency, and any clinical research experience.

**Join our team and make a difference in women's healthcare by providing exceptional patient care and supporting research that advances women's health.**

Pay: From $16.90 per hour

Work Location: In person

* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* Experience with domestic or international travel coordination
* Experience as an executive assistant supporting a senior leader, or in a comparable role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in the entertainment industry

Johnson Controls is hiring a Life Safety Service Rep, Electronic to support Fire/Life Safety service offerings and Electronic Services (Moves, Adds and Changes) for customers and end users within an assigned territory and account base. This field sales role focuses on building trusted customer relationships, developing solutions, and turning opportunities into long-term service business.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

In this role, you will manage a full sales cycle for fire alarm and life safety service work, from uncovering opportunities and shaping a value proposition to preparing proposals, negotiating terms, closing business, and supporting the customer after the sale. You will represent the company professionally in the field while coordinating with internal teams to deliver a complete customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Payrate:** ~$28~35.55/h DOE

**Contract Period:** 1 year

**Work location:** Santa Ana, CA

**Work Hours**: Monday – Friday , 8:30 AM~5:30 PM

 **Job Description**

**1. Position Overview**

The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air & Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to warehouses and ultimately to customers.

This position requires hands-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. As our operation supports global transportation across multiple time zones, this position follows a five-day work schedule that includes weekend shifts based on operational requirements.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

1) Planning & Scheduling

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations

2) Port & Terminal Coordination

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.
* Monitor and confirm on-time departures from U.S. Ocean terminals and major airports.
* Coordinate terminal departure schedules with terminal operators and customs brokers.

3) Movement Monitoring

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).

4) Transload Warehouse Management

* Oversee Transload Warehouse (TW) capacity planning and utilization.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.

5) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.

6) Partner & Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.

7) Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

8) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 **Qualifications**

1) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

2) Experience

* Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.

3) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures

4) Technical Skills

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.

5) Language

* English

6) Weekend work may be required.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're hiring our first Global Account Managers to own and aggressively grow a small number of our largest global accounts — companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce.

Accounts of this scale are not one company; they're dozens. Amazon alone runs research across retail, devices, AWS, advertising, and entertainment, in a dozen countries, with separate budgets and separate buying centers in each. We're already inside these organizations and the teams who use us love us. What we don't yet have is someone whose entire job is to turn a strong foothold into an enterprise-wide standard. That's this role.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales. You'll carry full commercial ownership of your accounts — expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal — and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You will not be working a wide territory or chasing net-new logos. You'll be going deep in a handful of the most important companies in the world, finding net new buying centers and getting introduced via referrals, building the relationships and the multi-year plan that make Outset the way they understand their customers.

You'll do it with a team around you. Each global account is supported by a dedicated account team — Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team. You set the strategy and direct the effort; the resources are there to execute it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own a portfolio of a small number of strategic global accounts — companies on the scale of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce — with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Find new buying centers, both regionally and within the larger umbrella brand, to pursue, predominantly via deep account understanding, referrals and in-person visits.
* Carry and exceed an aggressive seven-figure growth target across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each logo: every buying center by business unit, region, and research function; whitespace and spend map; executive relationship map; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Multi-thread relentlessly — from practicing researchers to VPs to the C-suite — and build senior relationships durable enough to survive champion turnover, reorgs, and procurement cycles.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors), setting priorities and holding the plan together across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that reframe the relationship around business outcomes, not usage stats, and convert them into committed budgets.
* Negotiate and close complex enterprise agreements — global MSAs, enterprise-wide and multi-region commitments, multi-year structures, enterprise procurement, security and privacy review — in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Coordinate coverage globally, aligning our regional teams behind a single account strategy rather than a set of local ones.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of your accounts back into Outset — informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion itself.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in enterprise sales, including 5+ years in a named global or strategic account role (Global Account Manager, Global Account Director, Strategic Account Manager, or equivalent) owning a small book of major brands.
* Direct experience selling into and growing accounts of this profile — large, global, matrixed technology or consumer organizations with many buying centers, such as Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Salesforce.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts* — expansion, cross-sell, and renewal — not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management. You are known for the depth and durability of the relationships you build, and you can point to accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with CxO and VP-level buyers, consultative enough to teach and shape their thinking, and comfortable negotiating at scale.

* Experience navigating complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor — a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* High ownership, opinionated, proactive, and comfortable with a very fast pace of both decision-making and execution in a startup that is still building the playbook.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Expansion
jobs.description:
**About Brightidea**
--------------------

Brightidea is the enterprise innovation management platform behind programs at Merck, J&J, AWS, Cytiva, and hundreds of other global organizations. We've been at this for 26 years, we're profitable, which means small surface area, short decision paths, and a lot of leverage per person.

**About the role**
------------------

You own a book of large, under-penetrated Fortune 1000 accounts where Brightidea holds a beachhead — a single department, a single program, a fraction of what the organization could be running. Your job is to crack those accounts open: build executive sponsorship from a small footprint, multi-thread across a complex organization, and grow toward enterprise-wide adoption while protecting what's already in place.

This is a hunter-builder seat, not a caretaker seat. It carries a real number and real accountability.

We've written it deliberately to screen out the standard enterprise SaaS account manager. If your value is relationship maintenance, QBR cadence, and renewal paperwork, this seat won't suit you and you won't enjoy it.

**Why this isn't a traditional Account Manager role**
-----------------------------------------------------

* **You have to build, not just sell.** Our customers are innovation leaders at Merck, J&J, AWS, Cytiva and their peers, and many of them are now building with AI themselves. You'll sit across from people who can prototype, and you need to prototype alongside them — mock a workflow, model a use case, turn platform usage data into a commercial case without waiting on an engineer or an analyst.
* **You have to hold the harder conversation.** A customer who can build their own tooling will ask why they need a platform at all. Answering that credibly means understanding both what we do and what is genuinely hard to replicate. A polished commercial pitch won't survive that conversation.
* **You'll find your own buyers.** Roughly a third of your book is net-new footprint inside existing logos — new business units, new use cases, new executive sponsors who have never heard of us. Nobody hands you that pipeline.
* **The business is changing underneath the role.** Brightidea is evolving how it engages large enterprises, and this seat sits at the front of that. If ambiguity bothers you, this is the wrong company right now. If you want a role where the shape of the work is still being decided, this is a good moment to arrive.
* **You carry a number and own the outcome.** Blended retention plus growth, reviewed monthly with your manager and quarterly with the executive team. The targets are in this document because we'd rather you know them before you apply.

**The bar: AI fluency is non-negotiable**
-----------------------------------------

This is a hard gate, not a preference. We won't make an offer to a strong commercial candidate who isn't genuinely AI-fluent, regardless of track record. We define it concretely:

* **You've built things.** Automations, agents, scripts, internal tools, integrations — something beyond prompting a chatbot. You should be able to walk us through what you built, why, and what broke.
* **AI is in your daily workflow, not your toolkit.** Account research, org mapping, territory planning, first-draft outreach, data analysis. We'll ask how you actually work, and we'll be able to tell.
* **You can produce a working artifact in front of a customer.** A mock, a prototype, a data cut, a solution sketch — fast enough to be useful in the meeting rather than in the follow-up.
* **You can reason about where AI helps and where it doesn't,** including the limits. We need someone who can tell a customer honestly that one thing is easy to build and another isn't.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Treat each account as a mini-territory: build and execute a penetration plan that moves it from beachhead toward enterprise-wide adoption
* Build executive sponsorship out from a single champion or department, multi-threading across large, political organizations where your original contact may not be your path to the budget
* Own renewal negotiation and close, including price increases and multi-year terms against enterprise procurement
* Source net-new buyers inside existing logos — new business units, adjacent use cases, executives who have never engaged with us
* Convert platform adoption and usage data into commercial cases; program results are your ammunition, and you should be able to pull and shape that data yourself
* Position Brightidea credibly against build-it-yourself alternatives, including customers prototyping with AI
* Forecast accurately and keep a clean cadence across ~25 accounts, concentrating effort where the runway is greatest

  

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

We care about the combination of commercial instinct and technical fluency, not the label on your last job. Three profiles fit:

* **Enterprise expansion** — you've carried a number expanding inside large, complex accounts, in an enterprise motion rather than SMB velocity. You've grown a logo from one business unit to enterprise-wide, or materially grown ARR inside a named account.
* **Consultant / solution architect** — you've delivered into large enterprises from a consulting or professional services background, with genuine commercial exposure: scoping, pricing, expanding engagements. You're comfortable being the person in the room who designs the answer.
* **Founder / operator** — you've built and sold something, carried revenue responsibility end to end, built your own tooling, and are comfortable with the ambiguity of an evolving business.

**Required across all three:**

* Experience navigating enterprise procurement, renewal negotiation, price increases, and multi-year terms
* Multi-threading in complex organizations, where you've built sponsorship starting from one contact and no budget
* A territory-development mindset with a concrete approach to whitespace

* Disability, Life and AD&D Insurance, 100% Company Paid

A reasonable estimate of total compensation for this role ranges between $70,304 - $150,000/Year and is a combination of base salary plus earned commissions. **Description**

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self-motivated, results-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
* Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical & analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

jobs.title: Youth Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco — Columbia Park Clubhouse  
San Francisco, CA | [Days], 25 hours/week during the school year and 40 hours/week during summer, in person | Part-time  
$23.50–$24.00/hr | Benefits Eligible

##### **Why This Role Matters**

Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character and community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a School-Based Club team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

##### **What You’ll Do**

Reporting to the Assistant Clubhouse Director, the Youth Development Coordinator supports the Columbia Park Clubhouse by delivering engaging, high-impact youth development programming for members ages 6 to 18. You’ll facilitate learning, arts, and recreation activities, guide positive member behavior, and keep daily Clubhouse operations and attendance tracking running smoothly.

* Facilitate engaging programs — Plan, run, and support age-appropriate educational, creative, and recreational activities, including homework help, tutoring, drop-in games, and technology, arts, and sports projects.
* Grow Learning Center participation — Promote department membership so every Club member actively takes part in Learning Center activities.
* Inspire future goals — Encourage members to prioritize academic success and build post-secondary goals, whether college, vocational training, or a career path.
* Create safe, creative spaces — Facilitate environments that encourage exploration while safeguarding the confidentiality and safety of all members.
* Support daily operations — Assist with school pick-ups, meal and snack service, games room activities, and outdoor recreation.
* Track attendance and reporting — Record daily program attendance and support administrative reporting under leadership guidance.
* Partner with volunteer tutors — Work with volunteer tutors and members to maintain an active educational improvement program.

##### **What You Bring**

###### **Required**

* Demonstrated experience working with youth ages 6 to 18 in a youth development setting
* Ability to quickly build strong, positive relationships with youth
* Strong behavior management and positive discipline skills, with high expectations for members
* Passion for diverse youth programming, including technology, art, sports, academics, and recreation
* Excellent verbal and written communication, research, and organizational skills
* Proficiency with PC software, including Microsoft Office and Adobe Photoshop
* Detail-oriented self-starter with the ability to build and follow systems in a fast-paced environment with continual distractions
* Current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification (or willing to obtain within 90 days of employment)

###### **Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) from an accredited college or university, or equivalent youth development experience
* Bilingual fluency in Spanish and English

##### **Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to lift 25 lbs.
* Must be able to stand for at least 2 hours consecutively.
* Must be able to sit at a computer workstation for long periods of time.

##### **Why BGCSF**

* Comprehensive health benefits, including employer contributions
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Education assistance
* Pre-tax Transportation Savings Account
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Generous Paid Time Off program
* Paid Holidays
* Life & Disability Insurance
* Professional development opportunities
* Free all-location West Coast Bay Club membership (for FT & PT after 90 days)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan: Pre-tax savings program with a discretionary employer contribution for eligible employees after completing one year of service.

##### **Compensation**

The wage range for this position is $23.50–$24.00 per hour. Final compensation is determined based on a range of factors, including skill set, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. Candidates may be hired at the entry, mid, or senior level of the range, depending on qualifications and position requirements.

##### **Pre-Employment Requirements**

As part of the hiring process, BGCSF requires candidates to complete LiveScan fingerprinting, a background check, and a tuberculosis (TB) evaluation or test.

##### **Disclaimer**

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work expected in this role. It is not intended as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. BGCSF reserves the right to reassign or relocate employees as needed.

To this end, in partnership with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), FPHNYC incubates innovative public health initiatives implemented by DOHMH to advance community health throughout the city. It facilitates partnerships, often new and unconventional, between government and the private sector to develop, test, and launch new initiatives. jobs.title: Language Justice Program Coordinator (FT, Temporary)
jobs.description:
About Masa
  
Masa partners with Mexican and Latin American immigrant children, youth, and families in the South Bronx to develop strong learners and leaders who fully contribute to the larger community. We envision a community that is civically engaged, empowered, and educated.
  
Masa’s community-led, integrated model engages the entire family, grounded in a deep commitment to strengthening literacy, leadership, and power for Mexican, Central American, and Indigenous People. Masa fosters a culturally responsive learning community in which families engage with direct service and advocacy programs to dismantle barriers to success.
  
About the Language Justice Program
  
The Language Justice Program seeks to deliver quality language services that empower historically marginalized voices, specifically indigenous speakers of Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). These communities are often hard-to-reach, underserved, and require interpretation and translation services to access critical services. Through this project, we provide economic and workforce development opportunities to Spanish and indigenous speakers by training them as community interpreters while simultaneously addressing the gap in language access for this community. The Language Justice program aims to strengthen our Community of Interpreter Program by training indigenous and Spanish speakers and launching a language services worker cooperative, ensuring this community has access to quality culturally and linguistically competent language services in the long-term.
  
About the Language Justice Coordinator
  
The Language Justice Coordinator will lead the work of our language justice programs, including but not limited to the outreach, recruitment and enrollment of new interpreters, implementation of adult educational classes that support the professional goals of the interpreters such as ESOL and/or Digital Literacy classes, managing the Community of Interpreter Program and dispatching interpretation and translation services, and providing continuous opportunities for interpreters in training to improve their practice. The Language Justice Coordinator reports to the Language Justice Program Manager and under their supervision will work closely with program consultants, trainers, and community members to ensure we continue to provide workforce development opportunities to our community and successfully deliver quality culturally and linguistically competent language services in our Community of Interpreter Program.
  
The ideal candidate will be passionate about language justice and empowering indigenous and immigrant communities; self-driven; possess experience in the area of adult education; and have strong project management skills, including the ability to set goals, plan timelines, allocate and coordinate resources, and manage tasks effectively.
  
This is a full-time, in-person role (40 hrs/week) that is planned to run through June 30, 2027 with the possibility of extension contingent on funding.
  
Key responsibilities
  
Recruitment, Outreach, and Enrollment
  
Coordinate the selection and onboarding process for potential cooperative members
  
Regularly meet with worker cooperative training participants individually to assess their needs, concerns, availability, commitment, training needs, and barriers that affect their participation
  
Provide technical assistance and engage consultants to provide training in business planning, democratic management, governance, legal, cooperative accounting, leadership development, decision-making, collective leadership models and cooperative development best practice
  
Develop a workplan and coordinate weekly working group and bi-weekly group meetings to ensure progress is being made towards successfully incorporating the worker cooperative
  
Remain abreast of and address group dynamics that may hinder progress
  
Support group in developing key documents and procedures for worker cooperative incorporation
  
Secure training opportunities for interpreters to continue to develop their practice and expand their menu of services
  
Maintain accurate records of participants, communications, attendance, progress, and outstanding need
  
Coordinate with organizational leadership and external partners to ensure continued alignment
  
Promote inclusive, transparent, equitable and language-justice-centered practices throughout the worker cooperative development process that ensures indigenous speakers and the original goals of the project are centered at all times and central to the decision-making process
  
Prepare progress updates, reports, recommendations, and documentation regarding the cooperative’s development
  
Requirements
  
Fluent in Spanish and English
  
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Community/Economic Development, or a related field required
  
2–4 years of experience in business development, non-profit program management, community organizing, or working within cooperative enterprises.
  
Strong group facilitation and conflict-resolution skills; ability to simplify complex business and legal concepts for diverse audiences.
  
Familiarity with basic business financial planning, cash flow forecasting, and operational bookkeeping.
  
Exceptional communication skills with a proven track record of guiding diverse stakeholder groups toward consensus, especially with immigrant, underserved and marginalized communities
  
Strong commitment to language justice, racial equity, economic justice and experience working directly alongside low-income, immigrant, or marginalized communities.

**Operations Coordinator, Communications**

**Overview:**

The Andrew Carnegie Foundation, originally established as Carnegie Corporation of New York, was founded in 1911 by Andrew Carnegie. Today, our funding supports the issues that Carnegie considered most important: education, democracy, and peace.

Our grantmaking is grounded in Andrew Carnegie’s vision to do “real and permanent good in the world,” and our mission is “to promote the advancement and diffusion of knowledge and understanding.” The award-winning Communications department oversees the content and marketing that tell the story of the foundation and its remarkable grantees. We operate as a combination of newsroom, creative agency, and marketing firm.

**Position Summary:**

The Andrew Carnegie Foundation is seeking an Operations Coordinator reporting to the Chief Communications Officer. The ideal candidate will be a utility player with plenty of initiative: a troubleshooter and problem solver who collaborates easily, takes ownership, and thrives at a fast pace – able to meet deadlines while juggling several priorities. Success in this role is helping the department to operate more efficiently and achieve greater impact. A background in communications and/or journalism is preferable, and strong Microsoft Office skills, especially Excel is required.

The Operations Coordinator will be responsible for providing administrative, budget, and operational support to a Communications team with twelve members; and will serve as executive assistant to the chief communications officer.

**Budget support:**

* Monitor and maintain the department’s budget; track expenditures and prepare monthly spending reports for the CCO; work with the CCO, the Communications team, and the Finance department to input all department expenses and reconcile finance report.

* Work with the printer and mailing house to maintain the subscription database for the *Carnegie Reporter* magazine and other print publications. Help organize lists of addresses, including changes and updates; and track inventory.

jobs.title: Event Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Hey there!
  
We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

**Meet the Team**

As part of the Operations team, you will join the Event Operations department. At Fever, this specialized team makes sure everything goes smoothly, from planning to execution. We support major launches, develop smart onsite solutions, train staff, and continuously improve efficiency through best practices and post-event analysis.

Within this department, our Onsite Coordinators are the ones who bring every event to life and ensure they meet the highest Fever standards. Join us if you're excited about making things happen and helping deliver flawless events!

**The role**

We are seeking a highly motivated, enthusiastic, and proactive Onsite Coordinator to join our Event Operations department. In this role, you will be on the ground, ensuring our experiences create unforgettable moments for people worldwide. If you have a process-oriented personality, a passion for operational excellence, and thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments, this is the perfect opportunity to make a real impact on our international business operations!

**What you'll do**

* Coordinate and manage on-site event staff; ensuring each staff member is trained in their duties whether it is validating tickets, guaranteeing all staff goes through Fever policies.
* Operations of the events:
* + Inventories: manage and control all devices used in the event (PDAs, computers, POS etc)
  + Validation: control the validation system and devices (Fever Partners App)
  + Flow: control flow of people throughout the entire experience avoiding bottlenecks, crowding and controlling queues
  + Onsite payment devices and accounts - F&B/Merch
* Handle onsite customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits.
* Follow communication procedures, guidelines, and policies
* Take the extra mile to engage customers
* Daily reporting to Fever Managers about the status of the event; including both the pre and post event findings and feedback, onsite incidences etc
* Point of contact between partner/production/onsite staff and Fever. The Onsite Coordinator will represent Fever Brand onsite and should know everything related to our Culture, Brand and Policies.

**Who you are**

* Fluency in English
* Desirable: Experience in event coordination roles
* Excellent face-to-face communication skills
* Highly organized and efficient; time management skills are key
* A problem-solver with the ability to think strategically and efficiently when faced with on-site issues
* Willing to learn from mistakes and give feedback on ways of improving the experiences
* Collaborative approach and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
* Be decisive and organized
* Love being part of a dynamic team in a growing company

**IMPORTANT**: Flexibility and availability to work rotating shifts (09:00–18:00 / 09:30–18:30), including weekends as scheduled.

Visa/permits - The candidate must be able to work in the event country and achieve one of the following:

(1) Already a citizen/resident in the country and is permitted to work.

(2) Already in possession of a work visa/permit.

  

#### **Perks & Benefits**

* Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
* Compensation package consisting on a base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
* Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
* Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
* Health, dental and vision insurance!

* **Competitive Compensation:** Base salary of **$47,000 USD/year**, plus an annual performance bonus of up to **10%**.

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're hiring our first Global Account Managers to own and aggressively grow a small number of our largest global accounts — companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce.

Accounts of this scale are not one company; they're dozens. Amazon alone runs research across retail, devices, AWS, advertising, and entertainment, in a dozen countries, with separate budgets and separate buying centers in each. We're already inside these organizations and the teams who use us love us. What we don't yet have is someone whose entire job is to turn a strong foothold into an enterprise-wide standard. That's this role.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales. You'll carry full commercial ownership of your accounts — expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal — and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You will not be working a wide territory or chasing net-new logos. You'll be going deep in a handful of the most important companies in the world, finding net new buying centers and getting introduced via referrals, building the relationships and the multi-year plan that make Outset the way they understand their customers.

You'll do it with a team around you. Each global account is supported by a dedicated account team — Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team. You set the strategy and direct the effort; the resources are there to execute it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own a portfolio of a small number of strategic global accounts — companies on the scale of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce — with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Find new buying centers, both regionally and within the larger umbrella brand, to pursue, predominantly via deep account understanding, referrals and in-person visits.
* Carry and exceed an aggressive seven-figure growth target across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each logo: every buying center by business unit, region, and research function; whitespace and spend map; executive relationship map; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Multi-thread relentlessly — from practicing researchers to VPs to the C-suite — and build senior relationships durable enough to survive champion turnover, reorgs, and procurement cycles.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors), setting priorities and holding the plan together across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that reframe the relationship around business outcomes, not usage stats, and convert them into committed budgets.
* Negotiate and close complex enterprise agreements — global MSAs, enterprise-wide and multi-region commitments, multi-year structures, enterprise procurement, security and privacy review — in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Coordinate coverage globally, aligning our regional teams behind a single account strategy rather than a set of local ones.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of your accounts back into Outset — informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion itself.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in enterprise sales, including 5+ years in a named global or strategic account role (Global Account Manager, Global Account Director, Strategic Account Manager, or equivalent) owning a small book of major brands.
* Direct experience selling into and growing accounts of this profile — large, global, matrixed technology or consumer organizations with many buying centers, such as Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Salesforce.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts* — expansion, cross-sell, and renewal — not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management. You are known for the depth and durability of the relationships you build, and you can point to accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with CxO and VP-level buyers, consultative enough to teach and shape their thinking, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority — you make the people around you more effective on your accounts.
* Experience navigating complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor — a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* High ownership, opinionated, proactive, and comfortable with a very fast pace of both decision-making and execution in a startup that is still building the playbook.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Orveon is a new kind of beauty company on a powerful mission: to change the way the world thinks about beauty. We dare to do things differently — pushing boundaries with purpose, inspiring creativity, and moving with intention in everything we do.

We are a collective of three premium and prestige beauty brands: bareMinerals, BUXOM, and Laura Mercier. With offices in New York, London, and Columbus, we combine the energy of an entrepreneurial spirit with the scale and ambition to change the way the world thinks about beauty.

Our culture is built on our IMPACT values — Innovative, Motivated, Passionate, Accountable, Collaborative, and Thoughtful. These aren't just words; they define how we show up for each other, for our brands, and for the world around us. We gain strength from our differences and believe that progress happens when we move as one. We are proud to offer a hybrid work model to support the work-life balance of our teams, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive, agile environment where everyone can thrive.

**About the Role**

The Account Lead is responsible for developing and executing strategic account plans for key wholesale partners. This role requires exceptional leadership, analytical capabilities, and cross-functional collaboration to drive sales growth, secure retail opportunities, and achieve business objectives. The Account Lead serves as the primary point of contact for assigned retailers and partners, managing all aspects of the account from strategic planning to execution and reporting.

Primary Responsibilities:

### **Strategic Planning & Account Management**

* Develop and implement comprehensive account strategy to drive sales growth and achieve sales goals
* Identify and capitalize on risks and opportunities to drive business forward
* Build and maintain strong relationships with retail partners and leverage those relationships for mutual interests and growth
* Develop cohesive strategy with BAM, Events, and Education teams to create 360-degree activations within assigned retail environments
* Negotiate and secure high-impact opportunities in retailer environments to maximize visibility and sales

### **Reporting & Analytics**

* Complete and manage revenue books; present findings and insights in revenue calls
* Track and analyze space change impacts to account for proper inventory allocation
* Present Read & React slides to communicate performance and insights to stakeholders
* Respond to Business Analysis & Reporting (BAR) and Board of Directors (BOD) asks with comprehensive analysis and presentations
* Analyze business results and respond to ad-hoc requests from leadership

### **Forecasting & Demand Planning**

* Forecast gross revenue for replenishment to ensure adequate inventory availability
* Forecast retail sales omni-channel and by channel with weekly breakouts
* Forecast innovation forecasts including initial sell-in pipeline and monthly sell-out projections
* Manage contractual deductions including DIFs and COOP agreements
* Forecast promotional activity and secondary/off-shelf placement needs

### **Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead calls and establish agendas with merchant partners
* Lead calls and establish agendas with Marketing, Planning & Inventory (MP&I) team

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

eBay Advertising is building a brand advertising business. You will be the strategic relationship owner overseeing a group of brand advertisers, responsible for driving campaign success, deepening partnerships, and growing revenue over time.

  
  

This role sits at the intersection of business development and client services. You will onboard new brand partners, manage their advertising programs end-to-end, and proactively find opportunities to expand their investment in eBay's platform. You are as comfortable pulling campaign data as you are presenting a strategic growth plan to a VP of Marketing.

  
  

This is a foundational hire for a team that is growing. You will help shape how we manage brand relationships at eBay and will be a bridge between our advertisers, our product team, and our go-to-market organization.
